title: Install and enable TLP for battery saving
summary: TLP is a tool that automatically optimizes laptop battery life. Installing and enabling it applies power-saving settings immediately without complex configuration.

steps.explain: Install the TLP package using the package manager.
Enable and start the TLP service so it runs on boot and immediately.
Mask the systemd-rfkill service and socket to prevent conflicts with TLP's radio management.

rollback.explain: Disable and stop the TLP service.

warnings: Masking systemd-rfkill prevents other tools from managing radio switches via systemd; TLP will handle this instead.
